title: Test cricketers score quickly during the 'nervous nineties': Evidence from a regression discontinuity design.
authors: Roberts L, Little DR, Jackson M, Spittal MJ.
figures: RD estimates of the number of runs per ball.  Note: Unadjusted mean runs are averaged over innings, matches and players and do not account for each components’ separate intercept. Adjusted mean runs are averaged over the model’s random intercepts.

RD estimates of the probability of a boundary.  Note: Unadjusted probabilities are averaged over innings, matches and players and do not account for each players’ separate intercept. Adjusted probabilities of a boundary are averaged over the model’s random intercepts.

RD estimates of the probability of dismissal.  Note: Unadjusted probabilities are averaged over innings, matches and players and do not account for each players’ separate intercept. Adjusted probabilities of a dismissal are averaged over the model’s random intercepts.
